objective.text: Preserve intentional collection keys instead of relying on default resource reindexing.

difficulty.rationale: Preserve intentional identifiers in an API object instead of silently reindexing them.

runtime.sapi: Isolated CLI Laravel harness unless another context is explicitly stated
runtime.errorPolicy: E_ALL; UTC; no external services or application data

stem: An item resource collection is keyed by stable external codes, and clients require those keys. Default serialization reindexes the collection. Which item-resource setting preserves them?

options.rationale: Changing the outer wrapper name does not preserve inner collection keys.
options.misconception: Changing the outer wrapper name does not preserve inner collection keys.

options.rationale: The resource collection uses this opt-in to retain the original collection keys.

options.text: Add each code to the model’s $hidden list.
options.rationale: Hiding model attributes does not configure collection-key preservation.
options.misconception: Hiding model attributes does not configure collection-key preservation.

options.text: Call values() on the collection before creating resources.
options.rationale: values explicitly discards existing keys and assigns sequential ones.
options.misconception: values explicitly discards existing keys and assigns sequential ones.
